convertibility_reason: EA relies on external .mqh libraries (SignalADX-MA.mqh, Expert.mqh, MoneyFixedLot.mqh) for its core trading signal generation and money management. The entry/exit logic is encapsulated in CSignalADX_MA class from an external include, not implemented inline, making it impossible to extract exact entry conditions without reading the library source.

other_exits: CExpert framework may close on opposing signal via CSignalADX_MA reversal logic

position_sizing.conditional_logic: CMoneyFixedLot uses Percent for margin allocation and Lots for fixed lot size; Lots=0.1 is the default fixed size

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal is fully encapsulated in CSignalADX_MA class from SignalADX-MA.mqh. The ADX minimum threshold (22.0) acts as a trend-strength gate: signals are only generated when ADX >= 22.0. The MA crossover direction determines long vs short. Expert_EveryTick=false means the EA processes only on new bar completion, not every tick. Magic number 13072. The CExpert base class handles position management including reversal closes.
python_conversion_notes: The CSignalADX_MA class must be reverse-engineered from the SignalADX-MA.mqh include to extract exact crossover logic (which MA method, applied price, and whether it compares price vs MA or fast MA vs slow MA). ADX filter is a simple threshold gate. SL/TP are fixed-point values (400/900 points) — must divide by point multiplier for target platform. No digit adjustment detected in this file but the CExpert framework may handle it internally. The CExpert base class manages position lifecycle, so conversion requires reimplementing: (1) new bar detection, (2) ADX+MA signal evaluation, (3) position open/close with SL/TP, (4) fixed lot sizing. Trailing is explicitly disabled (TrailingNone).
